onboarding.headline: Your health, made simple
onboarding.body: Ask health questions, understand your prescriptions and keep your records in one place, in your own language.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: You can change it any time from your profile.

role.title: Who is using the app?
role.body: Pick a role to explore. Demo mode needs no account.
role.patient: Ask health questions, read prescriptions, keep your records.
role.asha: Home visits, risk alerts and referrals, even offline.
role.doctor: Scan a QR health card and see the full history.
role.admin: Manage doctors, ASHA workers and hospital data.

phone.title: Sign in with your phone
phone.body: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS.
phone.demoHint: Demo mode: no SMS is sent. Use the code 123456.
phone.invalidCode: That code is not right. In demo mode, use 123456.
